arxiv-2012-07318.title: UVIT study of UV bright stars in the globular cluster NGC 4147
arxiv-2012-07318.creator: Ranjan Kumar 1*, Ananta C. Pradhan 1*, Mudumba Parthasarathy 2, Devendra K. Ojha 3, Abhisek Mohapatra 1, Jayant Murthy 2, and Santi Cassisi 4,5
arxiv-2012-07318.description: Abstract We present far ultraviolet (FUV) observations of globular cluster NGC 4147 using three FUV filters, BaF2 (F154W), Sapphire (F169M), and Silica (F172M) of Ultra-Violet Imaging Telescope (UVIT) on-board the AstroSat satellite. We confirmed the cluster membership of the UVIT observed sources using proper motions from Gaia data release 2 (GAIA DR2).

arxiv-2204-00158.title: Some 2-adic conjectures concerning
arxiv-2204-00158.creator: polyomino tilings of Aztec diamonds
arxiv-2204-00158.description: Abstract For various sets of tiles, we count the ways to tile an Aztec diamond of order n n using tiles from that set. The resulting function f ⁡ ( n ) f(n) often has interesting behavior when one looks at n n and f ⁡ ( n ) f(n) modulo powers of 2.

arxiv-2207-03567.title: Towards Optimal Integrated Planning of Electricity and Hydrogen Infrastructure for Large-Scale Renewable Energy Transport
arxiv-2207-03567.creator: Sleiman Mhanna, Member, IEEE Isam Saedi, Student Member, IEEE Guanchi Liu, Student Member, IEEE Pierluigi Mancarella, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2207-03567.description: Abstract The imminent advent of large-scale green hydrogen (H 2 ) production raises the central question of which of the two options, transporting “green” molecules, or transporting “green” electrons, is the most cost-effective one. This paper proposes a first-of-its-kind mathematical framework for the optimal integrated planning of electricity and H 2 infrastructure for transporting large-scale variable renewable energy (VRE).

arxiv-2212-02799.title: Rigidity of projective symmetric manifolds of Picard number 1 associated to composition algebras
arxiv-2212-02799.creator: Yifei Chen, Baohua Fu, Qifeng Li
arxiv-2212-02799.description: Abstract Abstract. To each complex composition algebra {\mathbb A} is associated a projective symmetric manifold X({\mathbb A}) of Picard number 1 , which is just a smooth hyperplane section of one of the following varieties: \mathop{\rm Lag}\nolimits(3,6),\quad\mathop{\rm Gr}\nolimits(3,6),\quad{\mathbb S}_{6},\quad E_{7}/P_{7}.

arxiv-2403-17357.title: MESIA: Understanding and Leveraging Supplementary Nature of Method-level Comments for Automatic Comment Generation
arxiv-2403-17357.creator: Xinglu Pan, Chenxiao Liu, Yanzhen Zou, Tao Xie, Bing Xie
arxiv-2403-17357.description: Abstract . Code comments are important for developers in program comprehension. In scenarios of comprehending and reusing a method, developers expect code comments to provide supplementary information beyond the method signature. However, the extent of such supplementary information varies a lot in different code comments.

arxiv-2405-13412.title: Sudden change of genuine multipartite entanglement in non-Markovian dynamics
arxiv-2405-13412.creator: Mazhar Ali
arxiv-2405-13412.description: Abstract We investigate entanglement dynamics of bipartite as well multipartite systems beyond Markov approximation. We study two pairs of cavity-reservoir systems, modeled as four qubits and track the change of entanglement among cavity-cavity qubits, reservoir-reservoir qubits, and also for genuine entanglement of all four qubits. For cavity-cavity qubits, we find that non-Markovianity prolongs the life of entanglement besides collapse/revival phenomenon.

arxiv-2410-02913.title: Conditional Non-Soficity of p-adic Deligne Extensions: on a Theorem of Gohla and Thom
arxiv-2410-02913.creator: Michael Chapman, Yotam Dikstein, Alexander Lubotzky
arxiv-2410-02913.description: Abstract A long standing problem asks whether every group is sofic, i.e., can be separated by almost-homomorphisms to the symmetric group Sym ​ ( n ) \textup{Sym}(n) . Similar problems have been asked with respect to almost-homomorphisms to the unitary group U ⁡ ( n ) U(n) , equipped with various norms.

arxiv-2505-10939.title: GenKnowSub: Improving Modularity and Reusability of LLMs through General Knowledge Subtraction
arxiv-2505-10939.creator: Mohammadtaha Bagherifard, Sahar Rajabi, Ali Edalat, Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh
arxiv-2505-10939.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mohammadtaha Bagherifard, Sahar Rajabi, Ali Edalat, Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh. Large language models (LLMs) often struggle with zero-shot generalization, and several modular approaches have been proposed to address this challenge. Yet, we hypothesize that a key limitation remains: the entanglement of general knowledge and task-specific adaptations. To overcome this, we propose a modular framework that disentangles these components by constructing a library of task-specific LoRA modules alongside a general-domain LoRA.

arxiv-2506-01611.title: Lessons Learned from the URGENT 2024 Speech Enhancement Challenge
arxiv-2506-01611.creator: Wangyou, Kohei, Samuele, Robin, Chenda, Zhaoheng, Anurag, Marvin, Wei, Yihui, Shinji, Tim, Yanmin
arxiv-2506-01611.description: Abstract The URGENT 2024 Challenge aims to foster speech enhancement (SE) techniques with great universality, robustness, and generalizability, featuring a broader task definition, large-scale multi-domain data, and comprehensive evaluation metrics. Nourished by the challenge outcomes, this paper presents an in-depth analysis of two key, yet understudied, issues in SE system development: data cleaning and evaluation metrics.

arxiv-2508-16954.title: Involutive root-graded Lie algebras and Lie tori of type A A Thanks: This work is based upon research funded by Iran National Science Foundation (INSF) under project No. 4001480. Thanks: This research was in part carried out in the IPM-Isfahan Branch.
arxiv-2508-16954.creator: Saeid Azam, Mehdi Izadi Farhadi
arxiv-2508-16954.description: Abstract . We investigate the concept of a “Chevalley involution” within the framework of root-graded Lie algebras with compatible grading. We provide a characterization of all centerless Lie tori of type A ℓ ​ ( ℓ ≥ 2 ) A_{\ell}(\ell\geq 2) admitting a Chevalley involution.

arxiv-2511-20720.title: DeeAD: Dynamic Early Exit of Vision-Language Action for Efficient Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2511-20720.creator: Haibo Hu, Lianming Huang, Nan Guan, Chun Jason Xue
arxiv-2511-20720.description: Abstract . Vision-Language Action (VLA) models unify perception, reasoning, and trajectory generation for autonomous driving, but suffer from significant inference latency due to deep transformer stacks. We present DeeAD , a training-free, action-guided early-exit framework that accelerates VLA planning by evaluating the physical feasibility of intermediate trajectories.

pmc-10742429.title: Hepatic Portal Venous Gas (HPVG) after Ingestion of Chlorine Bleach: A Transient Phenomenon
pmc-10742429.creator: Francesco M Arico, Francesco Buemi, Pietro Pitrone, Claudio Giardina, Renato Trimarchi, Flavia Borruto, Sarah Doria, Cristina Turiaco, Simona Caloggero, Romaric Loffroy, Robbert J de Haas
pmc-10742429.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). We present a case involving a 32-year-old man who ingested chlorine bleach with self-defeating intent. The ingestion of bleach can lead to a wide range of consequences, from mild mucosal burns to severe complications, rarely resulting in death. This case highlights the association between chlorine bleach ingestion and the development of hepatic portal venous gas (HPVG), a radiological finding traditionally thought to carry poor prognoses. The HPVG in this case resolved spontaneously within 24 h with conservative management, indicating its transient nature.

pmc-10783875.title: Multi-task bioassay pre-training for protein-ligand binding affinity prediction
pmc-10783875.creator: Jiaxian Yan, Zhaofeng Ye, Ziyi Yang, Chengqiang Lu, Shengyu Zhang, Qi Liu, Jiezhong Qiu
pmc-10783875.description: Protein–ligand binding affinity (PLBA) prediction is the fundamental task in drug discovery. Recently, various deep learning-based models predict binding affinity by incorporating the three-dimensional (3D) structure of protein–ligand complexes as input and achieving astounding progress. However, due to the scarcity of high-quality training data, the generalization ability of current models is still limited.

pmc-11303553.title: Timber trade in 17th-century Europe: different wood sources for artworks of Flemish painters
pmc-11303553.creator: Andrea Seim, Johannes Edvardsson, Aoife Daly, Pascale Fraiture, Ian Tyers, Willy Tegel, Rūtilė Pukienė, Tomasz Wazny, Maite Jover de Celis, Joost Vander Auwera, Justin Davies
pmc-11303553.description: The former Spanish Netherlands experienced a period of social, cultural and economic prosperity in the seventeenth century, with Antwerp as its most important commercial and artistic centre. The era’s vibrant art scene, once pivotal culturally, economically, and diplomatically, now offers invaluable insights for scientific studies on art, trade, and craftsmanship.

pmc-11472512.title: Private hospitals in low- and middle-income countries: a typology using the cluster method, the case of Morocco
pmc-11472512.creator: Saad Zbiri, Abdelali Belghiti Alaoui, Imad El Badisy, Najib Diouri, Sanaa Belabbes, Radouane Belouali, Zakaria Belrhiti
pmc-11472512.description: BackgroundThe private healthcare sector has become an essential component of healthcare systems globally. This interest has increased with the universal health coverage agenda. However, in most low- and middle-income countries, few classificatory studies of the private hospital sector were carried out.

pmc-11650778.title: Mechanistic Insights and Technical Challenges in Sulfur-Based Batteries: A Comprehensive In Situ/Operando Monitoring Toolbox
pmc-11650778.creator: Jing Yu, Ivan Pinto-Huguet, Chao Yue Zhang, Yingtang Zhou, Yaolin Xu, Alen Vizintin, Juan-Jesús Velasco-Vélez, Xueqiang Qi, Xiaobo Pan, Gozde Oney, Annabel Olgo, Katharina Märker, Leonardo M. Da Silva, Yufeng Luo, Yan Lu, Chen Huang, Eneli Härk, Joe Fleming, Pascale Chenevier, Andreu Cabot, Yunfei B
pmc-11650778.description: Batteries based on sulfur cathodes offer a promising energy storage solution due to their potential for high performance, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability. However, commercial viability is challenged by issues such as polysulfide migration, volume changes, uneven phase nucleation, limited ion transport, and sluggish sulfur redox kinetics.

pmc-11710441.title: MR1‐ and MAIT cell‐dependent pathology in a mouse model of AD
pmc-11710441.creator: Randy R Brutkiewicz
pmc-11710441.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundWe have found that the MHC class I‐like MR1 molecule and the innate‐like T cells that recognize them (MAIT—mucosal‐associated invariant T cells) contribute to the development of pathology in Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Moreover, we find elevated levels of MR1 expression and increased numbers of MAIT cells in the brains of 5XFAD mice overtime; these MAIT cells express high surface levels of the T cell activation markers, CD25 and CD69.

pmc-12731344.title: Clinical Management of Worn Ball Abutments in Mandibular Mini-Implant Overdentures: A Case Report in a Skeletal Class II Patient
pmc-12731344.creator: Cătălina Murariu-Măgureanu, Elena Preoteasa, Cristian Teodorescu, Cristina Teodora Preoteasa, Timothy L Hottel
pmc-12731344.description: Background/Objectives: Complete denture rehabilitation in edentulous patients presents functional and biomechanical challenges. Mini-implant-supported overdentures improve retention, stability, function, and comfort, particularly in complex class II or class III mandibulo-maxillary relationships. However, mechanical complications such as ball abutment wear may compromise long-term success.

pmc-13146200.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1929 HAEMATOMA EXPANSION AND THROMBOTIC EVENTS IN PATIENTS WITH FACTOR XA-INHIBITOR ASSOCIATED INTRACEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE—INTERIM ANALYSIS OF FIRE-XA
pmc-13146200.creator: Janis Rauch, Diego von Werdt, Christian Nolte, Mira Katan, Susanne Wegener, Stefan T Gerner, Gian Marco De Marchis, Sven Poli, Jan Purrucker, David Seiffge
pmc-13146200.description: Background and aimsIntracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) associated with recent factor Xa inhibitor (FXaI) intake warrants reversal therapy to prevent haematoma expansion but may increase the risk of thrombotic events (TE). We thought to provide a contemporary update on the use of reversal agents and early TEs.

pmc-13226496.title: Spatiotemporal patterns of gene expression changes in the mouse dentate gyrus following entorhinal denervation
pmc-13226496.creator: Jessica Schlaudraff, Domenico Del Turco, Jana Key, Thomas Deller, Georg Auburger
pmc-13226496.description: IntroductionThe central nervous system responds to acute injury with plastic remodeling of its network. However, the temporal and structural dynamics of this response in the denervated dentate gyrus remain poorly understood. Therefore, we examined the transcriptional programs activated after perforant path transection, focusing on the outer molecular layer (OML) and the granule cell layer (GCL).

pmc-13412211.title: Microbiota-Based Interventions Differentially Rescue Gut and Social Behavior Phenotypes in Drosophila with Kdm5 Deficiency
pmc-13412211.creator: Natalia A. Peta Martinez, Melanie Reinoso Arnaldi, Tasha M. Santiago-Rodriguez, Imilce A. Rodriguez-Fernandez
pmc-13412211.description: IntroductionAutism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a lifelong neurological and developmental disorder that is often accompanied by gastrointestinal (GI) issues. The bidirectional communication system known as the gut microbiota-brain axis may help explain how GI dysfunction contributes to neurological symptoms. Loss-of-function mutations in the histone demethylases KDM5A, KDM5B, or KDM5C are found in patients with intellectual disability and ASD.

pmc-13593475.title: Targeting SIRT3 dysfunction with a sprayable honokiol hydrogel for diabetic burn wound repair
pmc-13593475.creator: Min Li, Xuedong Yu, Huantao Hu, Kai Wen, Qiongfang Ruan, Paul Yao, Maolong Dong
pmc-13593475.description: BackgroundDiabetic burn wound healing is impaired by persistent mitochondrial oxidative stress, chronic inflammation, bacterial infection, and defective tissue regeneration. Although honokiol possesses antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, its therapeutic potential is limited by poor local retention. Moreover, the therapeutic significance of restoring mitochondrial sirtuin 3 (SIRT3) signaling in diabetic wound repair remains largely unexplored.

uslaw-usc-t19-s1.title: 19 U.S.C. § 1 — Organization of customs service
uslaw-usc-t19-s1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t19-s1.description: United States Code, Title 19 (Customs Duties); Chapter 1 (Collection Districts, Ports, And Officers). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Except as hereinafter provided the reorganization of the customs service made by the President and communicated to Congress under date of March 3, 1913, shall, until otherwise provided by Congress, constitute the permanent organization of the customs service.
